Bug_Title: "Math.abs" and negation should not be used on numbers that could be "MIN_VALUE"
Bug_Explanation: The bug is demonstrated by applying Math.abs on a random integer generated by Random.nextInt(). If the random integer is Integer.MIN_VALUE, Math.abs will return Integer.MIN_VALUE instead of the positive value due to integer overflow.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by setting the seed such that Random.nextInt() returns Integer.MIN_VALUE, causing Math.abs to incorrectly return Integer.MIN_VALUE due to integer overflow.
